analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간을 탈출했으나 여전히 중립 구간에 머물러 있으며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환을 확정하기에는 부족하다. ADX 32.3은 뚜렷한 추세를 시사하나, -DI가 +DI보다 높아 하락 압력이 우위에 있다. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.79로 거래량이 위축되어 있어 방향성 판단에 신뢰도가 낮다. 스윙 지지선 85,300원, 저항선 89,580원 사이에서 횡보하며 방향 탐색 중이다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI has exited oversold territory but remains in the neutral zone, and while the MACD histogram shows improvement, it's insufficient to confirm a trend reversal. ADX at 32.3 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is higher than +DI, suggesting downward pressure is dominant. The volume ratio of 0.79 compared to the 5-day average indicates subdued trading, lowering confidence in directional judgment. The price is consolidating between the swing support at 85,300 KRW and resistance at 89,580 KRW, searching for direction.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (88,905 KRW) above SMA5 (87,645 KRW), below SMA20 (97,995 KRW): short-term trend weak, medium-term trend below
· Significantly lower than SMA100 (112,254 KRW) and SMA200 (100,233 KRW): strong mid-to-long-term downtrend
· 52-week position (35.5%): current price level recovered from 52-week low but significantly down from high, historically speaking
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (27.4→36.5): attempting to enter neutral zone after exiting oversold, weak directional momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2406.4506→-963.6675): improving within negative territory, potential for bottoming but weak signal for trend reversal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 97,995 KRW): sideways near the middle band, band width of 41.79% implies potential for increased volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (85,300 KRW): key support zone near 52-week low and Pivot S1 (77,010 KRW)
· Swing Resistance (89,580 KRW): below 5-day high (91,390 KRW) and Pivot PP (94,940 KRW), potential for short-term bounce if broken
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways): no clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed, lack of direction
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.79): trading volume subdued compared to 5-day average, reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI exiting oversold and MACD improving signals present, but lack of volume makes directional confirmation difficult. Wait-and-see approach needed between swing support at 85,300 KRW and resistance at 89,580 KRW for direction confirmation.
